answer: River pigment trade-diversity bond: each identity locks 70 credits and must trade pigment with 20 independent counterparties on the river. A sable seal binds each trade; self-trades do not count, and auditors recompute the river log. A reused seal or under 20 counterparties burns it. One thousand fakes need 20,000 slots: 20,000 fees plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail: each needs its own key. An honest identity pays 20.
